claims.claim: GE Vernova Q2 2026 orders were $24.2B, up 88% organically, backlog reached $176B, and data-center orders exceeded $5B year-to-date, more than double full-year 2025.

factors.name: power bottleneck exposure
factors.basis: gas power and electrification demand are accelerating alongside data-center power needs

risks.risk: Large equipment backlog carries long-cycle manufacturing, supply-chain and project execution risk.

causalEdges.from: AI/data-center electricity demand and grid constraints
causalEdges.mechanism: new compute load requires dispatchable generation, grid equipment and services
causalEdges.falsifier: data-center order growth or gas/electrification backlog reverses materially

unknowns.unknown: Backlog margin mix and cancellation protections require deeper underwriting.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $11.1B, adjusted EBITDA $1.2B with 11.3% margin, and free cash flow $5.1B; GE Vernova raised 2026 revenue and free-cash-flow guidance.

factors.name: execution and cash conversion
factors.basis: revenue growth, margin expansion, cash generation and raised guidance moved together

risks.risk: Cash flow can be timing-sensitive in large equipment/project businesses.

causalEdges.mechanism: equipment/services deliveries convert contracted demand into revenue and cash
causalEdges.falsifier: working-capital reversal or margin compression persists despite backlog growth

unknowns.unknown: No canonical valuation conclusion is asserted.
